Limit[n=10]
  Sort[keys=revenue DESC, item_count DESC]
    Project[customer.mktsegment AS mktsegment, customer.nation AS nation, item_count, revenue]
      Filter[sum(lineitem.extended_price) > 5000.0]
        Aggregate[group=customer.mktsegment, customer.nation, aggs=count(*) AS item_count, sum(lineitem.extended_price) AS revenue]
          Filter[lineitem.ship_date >= '1995-01-01' AND orders.order_priority = '1-URGENT']
            Join[kind=inner, cond=orders.id = lineitem.order_id]
              Join[kind=inner, cond=customer.id = orders.cust_id]
                Scan[customer]
                Scan[orders]
              Scan[lineitem]
